author: Inside Edition
description: If you believe in Bigfoot, the International Cryptozoology Museum in Bangor, Maine, may be just the place. And if you don't believe in Bigfoot, it's still worth a visit. Among its collection, the museum features hundreds of casts of what may or may not be the footprints of the mysterious hairy creature. Christopher Packard, the museum's assistant director, told Inside Edition Digital that people "make fake footprints, and sometimes those are just as good of a story as the real experience."
title: Bigfoot, Mothman And Mermaids Are On Show At International Cryptozoology Museum
